Welcome to the live broadcast of the main and most fierce derby in Indonesia - the 'Super East Java Derby' ('Super Derbi Jatim'), where Persebaya Surabaya hosts its arch-rival, Arema FC, at the Gelora Bung Tomo Stadium. This match is more than just a game; it's a battle for honor, prestige, and regional dominance that is always characterized by incredible passion.

Persebaya Surabaya vs Arema FC: Match Preview

Both teams approach this match with extreme motivation, regardless of their positions in the league table. Persebaya is competing for the top spots in the championship and will be eager to please their army of fans (the 'Bonek') with a victory in the most important match of the season. Persebaya Surabaya

The 'Green Crocodiles,' under coach Paul Munster, rely on a fast, attacking style of football. At Gelora Bung Tomo, with the support of their fans, Persebaya plays with particular inspiration. The team will aim to dominate from the first minutes and exploit the weaknesses of their rivals. The leader of their attack is Brazilian winger Bruno Moreira, who is in excellent form.

Arema FC

The 'Crazy Lions' ('Singo Edan') will be fighting not just for points, but for their pride. The team will rely on fighting spirit, commitment, and fast counter-attacks. Despite being the underdogs in this away match, Arema is always capable of pulling off a surprise in the derby. In attack, all hopes are on the experience and skill of local striker Dedik Setiawan.
